rule: The counterbaseline must be small enough to represent a plausible permanent MVC feature path. A second billion-parameter VLM is not a fair Micro Visual Classifier baseline.

promotion_metric: full sensor->verified-outcome Pareto vector: task/open-set/action-verification correctness + cold/warm latency + CPU/RAM/VRAM + bytes moved + state growth + restart/version compatibility. No classifier-only promotion.
